{{verse|chapter=15|verse=14}} And I my {{ls}}elf al{{ls}}o, my brethren, am a{{ls}}{{ls}}ured of you, that you al{{ls}}o are ful of loue, repleni{{ls}}hed vvith al knowledge, {{ls}}o that you are able to admoni{{ls}}h one an other. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=15}} But I haue vvritten to you (brethren) more boldly in part, as it were putting you in remembrance: for the grace vvhich is giuen me of God, {{verse|chapter=15|verse=16}} to be the mini{{ls}}ter of Chri{{ls}}t {{sc|Iesvs}} in the Gentils: {{ls}}anctifying the Go{{ls}}pel of God, that the oblation of the Gentils may be made acceptable and {{ls}}anctified in the holy<noinclude>{{continues|Gho{{ls}}t.}}</noinclude>
